headline: It's Official: OnePlus is Pulling Out of the US and Europe
reasoning: This topic scores highly on clickability and viral potential, as the retreat of a well-known 'flagship killer' brand is dramatic news that will spark debate among tech enthusiasts. It has immense practical value for consumers considering their next phone purchase and offers excellent potential for diverse formats, such as 'Best OnePlus alternatives' listicles or 'Why OnePlus Failed in the West' hot takes.
summary: Phone maker OnePlus has officially confirmed it will stop launching new products in Europe and North America, though it will continue to provide support and software updates for existing devices.

source_articles.title: Phone maker OnePlus says it won’t release new phones in the US and Europe
source_articles.excerpt: OnePlus could also wind down its operations in India by 2027.
